name: Metadata Check
author: Synapse
description: Checks library records against current scholarly metadata every few days (three by default): changed fields, the published version of an arXiv preprint, and a newer arXiv version of its PDF, with a notification and the replacement to review. Suggestions you ignore stay hidden until something different turns up.

settings.label: Days between checks
settings.description: Days between two checks of the same item. Run Now checks everything at once.

settings.label: New arXiv versions
settings.description: Also check whether arXiv has a newer version of a preprint's PDF, and offer to replace it (its highlights are deleted with it).
